metric_role: Read frozen b12 per-request metric values unchanged; no generated text, new metric normalization, output-selected subset or rescoring. This is an auxiliary new-run contrast recipe, not replacement of historical reported statistics.

paired_contrast_statistics.interval: pointwise percentile 95%; keep all within-question paired observations in their article
paired_contrast_statistics.relation_to_frozen_summaries: Original b12 summary bootstrap remains 2000 draws/20261022. These additional E1/E2 contrasts explicitly use the historical contrast resampling recipe 10000/20261020 on newly scored b12 values.
paired_contrast_statistics.mcnemar: Two-sided exact binomial on discordant paired binary outcomes, no scipy or continuity correction.
paired_contrast_statistics.E1_Holm: Four tests per subset: two attacks x {reference_exact,target_exact}; all100 and original-supported85 are separate families within each model. Clean comparisons are descriptive and excluded. No across-model multiplicity adjustment or independent-model replication claim.
paired_contrast_statistics.E2: Exploratory within-policy setting-minus-clean and policy-minus-unfiltered differences in changes; the separate factual multiplicity contrast uses five-minus-one. No added significance family.

output_scope: Q returns fixed clean-utility summary pointer; E3 returns frozen-score pointers without additional attack-success definitions.
timing_disclosure: Receipt serializes the already declared auxiliary code recipe at analysis time; not a claim that the historical study was preregistered again.
